author: SpaceX
text: Flight director has verified GO for propellant load.

author: SpaceX
text: Live webcast of Starship's 14th flight test starts now.

author: SpaceX
text: Starship will deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites, the first operational payload flown on Starship.

author: NASASpaceflight
text: Super Heavy B21 splashes down in the Gulf after its landing burn.

author: SpaceX
text: Starship's ascent burn continues on its way to space.

author: Kyle Hill
text: Hmm, an engine out and then an alien battle cruiser uncloaks. Interesting.

author: Space.com
text: “The Go-No Go poll for orbit has finished, and we are Go for orbit,” Dan Huot says. The crowd at SpaceX's Starbase has erupted in cheers.

author: SpaceX
text: Starship performs its orbital insertion burn and enters orbit of Earth for the first time.

author: SpaceX
text: Starlink V3 satellites deploying from Starship.

author: Elon Musk
text: First orbital flight of Starship successful!

author: NASA Administrator
text: Congrats @SpaceX! … Gorgeous launch, getting Ship to orbit and managing every step in a safe, responsible, and especially inspirational way.

author: SpaceX
text: Live views of Starship in orbit brought to you by @Starlink

author: Starlink
text: Starlink enabling real-time video streaming from orbit

author: Starbase Tracker
text: Ship 41 is approaching landing just north of Hawaii

author: SpaceX
text: Splashdown confirmed. Congratulations to the entire SpaceX team on the first orbital flight of Starship!
